widgetTool.name: quick_actions
widgetTool.description: Emit quick-action chips for the user to tap. Use after every response that presents choices on webchat. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'Here are your options.' Emit it whenever widgets_enabled=True, INCLUDING while you are speaking -- on a voice-enabled webchat the customer has both ears and a screen, so showing and speaking are complementary, not alternatives. Speak a short line and emit the widget. Only describe it aloud instead when widgets_enabled=False.
